author: hattrill
body:
Yes, I put a note on this "The composition of the sorting nexin heterodimer may influence cargo selection. [Snx1](https://flybase.org/search/Snx1)/[Snx6](https://flybase.org/search/Snx6) are thought of as the classical retromer complex sorting nexins. In D.mel, [Snx3](https://flybase.org/search/Snx3) is required for the endocytic recycling of [wls](https://flybase.org/search/wls) ([FBrf0216871](https://flybase.org/reports/FBrf0216871.html))." 

So, seems sensible to remove it from the core complex.

Will do that now.
